name: order_lookup
description: Look up all orders for a customer by their customer ID. Returns order details including product name, status, and purchase date.

customer_id.description: The customer ID to look up orders for (e.g., C-01, C-02, C-03)

name: user_lookup
description: Retrieve customer information by customer ID. Returns the customer's name and country code.

customer_id.description: The customer ID to look up (e.g., C-01, C-02, C-03)

name: product_lookup
description: Retrieve product information by product ID. Returns product name, brand/provider, and category.

product_id.description: The product ID to look up (e.g., P-001, P-002, P-003)
